parameter_bounds.lookback: integer in [2, 100]; booleans, strings and fractional values are refused

warmup_rule: a decision needs lookback + 1 consecutive valid candles (prior and current %R); the manifest supplies 300 unscored warm-up bars and the live check window is 200 candles

range_regime_gate.timing: each bar's label comes from the trailing 200 rows ending at that bar with no shift; an entry decided on closed bar N is gated by bar N's label and fills at bar N+1 open; the gate blocks entries only

selection_rule.text: eligible = all datasets scored with complete candle and funding coverage, no liquidated leg, >= 10 independent positions; pick max mean Sharpe, then max mean DD-adjusted return, then earliest grid order; the same rule tunes every comparator on its own DEFAULT_PARAM_RANGES grid

inconclusive_when: candle or funding coverage incomplete on any held-out candidate or comparator leg
no eligible candidate combination on the training window
fewer than 30 independent held-out candidate positions
any held-out candidate or comparator leg with incomplete close parity
pass_requires: candidate mean net return > 0 at cost x1
candidate mean net return > 0 at cost x2
candidate mean Sharpe above each comparator's (selected, cost x1)
candidate mean DD-adjusted return above each comparator's (selected, cost x1)
candidate M1 incumbent verdict 'pass' on the held-out window
